text: I often hesitate before upgrading my notification settings when a new update drops. While more connectivity might sound good, the initial flood of alerts can lead to immediate digital burnout. By delaying the upgrade, I can observe my current workflow and decide which alerts are actually worth my mental energy. It is better to distinguish between useful data and persistent noise before everything starts pinging at once. Sometimes, the best notification is the one you never receive.
